content:
OpenSearch as well as 7.x versions of Elasticsearch have a default setting of no more than 1,000
shards per node. OpenSearch/Elasticsearch throw an error if a request, such as creating a new
index, would cause you to exceed this limit. If you encounter this error, you have several options:
• Add more data nodes to the cluster.
• Increase the _cluster/settings/cluster.max_shards_per_node setting.
• Use the _shrink API to reduce the number of shards on the node.
